title: Scouts UK
description: Scouts UK is known for its vibrant and diverse palette reflecting its inclusive and dynamic nature. The brand's colors, sourced from official brand guidelines, combine deep hues like Purple (4D2177) and Forest Green (004851) with bright accents like Yellow (FFCD00) and Orange (FF8200), representing both tradition and adventure. These colors are characterized as symbolizing nature, preparedness, and an adventurous spirit.
